entry.subject: 北宋中原 官署衙门（原创扩展；建筑细部待考）
entry.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated production city-map building sprite for tianshu, Northern Song central plains Kaifeng/Luoyang around 1093. Reference images supply only realistic ancient materials and detail density; never copy reference camera mistakes or southern lush vegetation. Historical realistic grey clay tile, warm grey plaster over earth and rough bricks, matte weathered timber; restrained subtle ochre and red where structural. NOT toy, plastic, miniature diorama or ink wash. Orthographic yaw45 elevation30, ground axes EXACT slopes +0.5/-0.5 (2:1 dimetric), parallel opposite edges, upright columns, NO perspective. South entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. Entire isolated footprint on one extremely thin flat ground-contact parallelogram with left, bottom/front and right corners clearly visible for grid calibration. Only a shallow masonry contact strip, NO thick plinth. Upper-left screen illumination, short contact shadow towards lower-right. TRUE transparent RGBA background, at least10% clear margins all sides. All roof ends and ground corners visible. No text, writing, signs, symbols, watermark, people, surrounding city, sky, trees outside footprint, modern objects, Qing ornament, imperial yellow roofs, thick bases or checkerboard. Subject: one Northern Song administrative yamen compound, a sober broad grey-tile timber main audience hall, one low side office wing and a small gatehouse in rough warm grey brick courtyard walls, open paved court. All within footprint 16m east-west by12m north-south; screen down-right front edge length / up-right edge length must be exactly16/12. Large wooden south gate on lower-left face, restrained structural bracketwork, unpainted lattice windows, blank surfaces. Original non-site-specific design, not a exact named heritage reconstruction. No gardens, no flags or drums. Geometry priority: make projected ground parallelogram corners in a1536x1024 canvas precisely left(90,535),front(858,919),right(1434,631),back(666,247), up to uniform scaling and translation. Its front long side points down-right slope0.5, short side points up-right slope-0.5. These are construction instructions, do NOT draw labels or guides. Place wall bottom edges exactly along this parallelogram. Keep the architecture shorter so the roof fits above. Make the ground boundary a paper-thin contact edge. All background must have alpha zero, no glow, no haze, no ambient gradient.
entry.negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、场景背景、厚底座、塑料感、清式重彩、黄琉璃宫顶、透视汇聚

references.role: 宋套件仅材质与写实细节参考；非本图几何或历史准确性背书

entry.created_time_basis: 源PNG文件mtime；非服务端披露调用时间

steps: one uniform LANCZOS resize with integer size rounding
pad RGBA; original alpha preserved; no thresholding, repaint, warp or flip

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工量可见薄底面三角点；后角遮挡推算，非测绘；残差不以几何变形修正

anchor_rounding_correction.reason: 按整数resize后的sx/sy转换，避免requested scale的亚像素偏移；未改图像或底面测点

entry.notes: 已逐张view_image原图与最终PNG自查。第二候选院落完整；入口左下，右轴仍偏陡，未以拉伸纠正。单视图；运行时拼接待实测；形制组合为原创扩展，细部待考。
